globalOverheadHelp.p1: Every worker you employ raises your company's overhead, which makes every worker across all your bases consume slightly more consumables. So a new production building doesn't just cost its own workers' supplies. It also nudges up the consumables every other building needs.
globalOverheadHelp.excludeBody: profit counts only the recipe's own direct costs. Use this when comparing recipes.
globalOverheadHelp.includeBody: profit also subtracts the ripple cost on the rest of your company. Use this when deciding whether constructing a new building is actually worth it.

vacationHelp.p1: Controls how bases flagged as on vacation in-game feed into the overhead burden. It is independent of the base page's own vacation toggle.
vacationHelp.liveBody: respects the in-game flag, so vacationing bases drop out of the overhead burden.
vacationHelp.noneBody: treats every base as fully active, as if all workforce were recalled.

displayMode.medalValuePerBurdenTooltip: Output value minus input cost at the game's average prices, per hour per 100 burden. Consumables, workforce and maintenance are ignored.
displayMode.profitTooltip: One building level's share of the profit per hour, after that level's slice of overhead.
displayMode.profitTotalTooltip: The whole building at its current level, per hour, after all overhead.
displayMode.profitMarginTooltip: Total profit as a share of output value.
displayMode.inputCostTooltip: What the inputs cost per hour, before workforce, maintenance and shipping.
displayMode.outputValueTooltip: What the outputs are worth per hour, before any cost is taken off.
displayMode.consumableCostTooltip: Workforce consumables and building maintenance per hour. Already subtracted from profit.
displayMode.profitPerBurdenTooltip: Total profit per hour for every 100 workforce burden.
displayMode.roiIncrementalTooltip: How long one more building level takes to pay for itself, including its housing and input reserve.
displayMode.roiTotalTooltip: How long the whole building at its current level takes to pay back, from nothing.
displayMode.weightIncreaseTooltip: How much heavier the outputs are than the inputs. Negative when the recipe compresses weight.
displayMode.profitPerWeightChangeTooltip: Per-level profit scaled by how much weight the recipe removes. Negative when it adds weight.
displayMode.profitPerTotalWeightTooltip: Per-level profit per tonne moved, counting inputs in and outputs out.
displayMode.profitPerMaxLegWeightTooltip: Per-level profit per tonne on the heavier leg alone, in or out.
displayMode.targetPriceTooltip: The output price that would hit the profit target for this tier.
displayMode.targetPricePerBurdenTooltip: The output price that would hit the per-100-burden profit target for this tier.
